h1: The Park Nine Hotel Suvarnabhumi — free hourly shuttle just 3 km from BKK Airport
intro: If you have an early morning flight or a late-night arrival at Suvarnabhumi and you want four-star comfort without paying the premium of the in-terminal Hyatt, The Park Nine Hotel Suvarnabhumi is one of the most-recommended choices in the Lat Krabang neighbourhood. The hotel sits just 3 kilometres — about 8 minutes by car — from Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK), and it runs a complimentary shuttle every hour around the clock. 114 rooms, an outdoor saltwater pool along a century-old canal, a breakfast buffet, gym, sauna, and restaurant Eat Drink Love. Rates start from around THB 1,800/night in the regular season, rising to THB 2,500–3,000 in high season (November through February). The hotel scores 8.9 out of 10 from over 2,400 verified guest reviews on Booking.com — consistently high marks for cleanliness, comfort, and staff.

body.html: The detail that makes The Park Nine stand apart from the dozens of budget options lining the Bangna-Trad corridor is its shuttle. Most airport-area hotels offer a fixed schedule of two or four runs per day — this one sends a free 8-seat Wi-Fi van every single hour, 24 hours a day. It collects guests at Gate 5, Level 2 of the terminal, and the drive to the hotel takes 8 minutes on a clear run. Whether your flight lands at 2 a.m. or departs at 5 a.m., there is a ride waiting — and reviewers cite this reliability again and again as the single biggest reason they rebook.

The property opened in 2017 and was designed around its centrepiece: a chlorine-free saltwater infinity pool that stretches along a century-old canal, flanked by tropical landscaping and sun loungers. The water clarity draws consistent praise in reviews — guests describe it as unusually clean and inviting for an airport-area hotel. A separate children's pool, a well-equipped gym, a men's sauna, and a women's steam room complete the wellness offering. For an 8-minute shuttle ride from the departures hall, it feels more like a garden resort than a layover pad.

Rooms span seven categories from Superior to a two-bedroom suite, with accessible rooms available throughout. Cleanliness and comfort are the words that dominate reviews — guests specifically mention Daikin air conditioning that cools rooms quickly, firm-but-comfortable mattresses, and soundproofed windows that cut most of the traffic noise from Lat Krabang Road. That said, rooms facing the street in lower categories can still let in the occasional motorbike at night; if you are a light sleeper, ask for a garden- or canal-facing room when booking.
"The shuttle was waiting exactly on time at 2 a.m. after a delayed flight. Room was large, spotless, and the pool the next morning was beautiful. Will absolutely stay again on every Bangkok layover."

The all-day restaurant Eat Drink Love blends Thai flavours with international comfort food and receives solid marks for its buffet breakfast — a live egg station, Thai noodles, fresh pastries, fruit and several local dishes. It is not the most expansive spread you will find in Bangkok, but it is genuinely fresh and adequate for a pre-flight meal. The in-hotel food and drinks are priced noticeably higher than the Robinson Lifestyle Mall directly across the street, so if budget matters, stock up over there.

The honest caveat: Lat Krabang is an airport neighbourhood, not a city base. There is no BTS or MRT station within easy reach, and getting to Sukhumvit or Siam takes 40 to 50 minutes by taxi depending on traffic. The hotel is ideal for one-night layovers, pre-flight stays, or short business trips to the industrial estates nearby — it was not designed for travellers who want to explore central Bangkok daily. If that is your plan, a hotel on the Sukhumvit line will serve you better.

Across all verified platforms, the numbers hold up. Booking.com: 8.9 / 10 from 2,405 reviews. Cleanliness 9.2, comfort 9.3, staff 9.2. Trip.com: 8.9 from 399 reviews. TripAdvisor: 4.4 bubbles from 565 reviews. The consistency across platforms — and the specificity of guest feedback about the shuttle, the pool, and the rooms — gives confidence that this is not a hotel gaming its scores, but one that simply delivers on a straightforward promise.

highlights.title: Free Hourly Shuttle, 24/7
highlights.text: Complimentary 8-seat Wi-Fi van runs every hour day and night between the hotel and Suvarnabhumi Airport — pick-up at Gate 5, Level 2. Reserve in advance due to limited seats.

highlights.title: Saltwater Pool Along the Canal
highlights.text: Chlorine-free outdoor saltwater infinity pool stretching beside a century-old canal, with tropical gardens, sun loungers, and a separate children's pool.

highlights.title: Breakfast Buffet + Spacious Clean Rooms
highlights.text: Freshly cooked breakfast buffet with a live egg station and Thai noodles. Rooms praised for size, cleanliness, and Daikin air conditioning that keeps things properly cool.

honestSummary: The Park Nine Suvarnabhumi is a genuinely strong choice for early-flight and layover travellers — the free hourly shuttle is the real deal, the saltwater pool is a genuine surprise, rooms are clean and large, and the breakfast is honest. Trade-off: it is an airport neighbourhood, not a city base, and you will need a taxi to reach any BTS station.
honestChecks: If you want to explore central Bangkok daily — Lat Krabang has no BTS or MRT, and taxis to Sukhumvit take 40–50 minutes → book a hotel on the Sukhumvit or Silom BTS line instead, and use the Airport Rail Link when you need to fly.
If you are sensitive to street noise — lower-category rooms facing Lat Krabang Road can let in motorbike sounds at night → request a garden-facing or canal-facing room when you make your reservation.

If you are on the tightest possible budget — there are 3-star hotels in Racha Thewa and King Kaew areas charging half the price with similar shuttle services → choose The Park Nine when room quality and the pool matter to you.

tips.title: Reserve Your Shuttle Seat in Advance
tips.body: The free shuttle runs every hour but holds only 8 passengers — email reservation@theparknine.com or call +66 (91) 810 0730 with your flight details to secure a seat, especially for overnight arrivals or peak travel periods.

tips.title: Use the Pool in the Morning
tips.body: The saltwater pool along the century-old canal is at its best in the early morning before the day heats up. If you check out in the afternoon, you can often still use the pool before heading back to the airport.

tips.title: Breakfast Before Your Flight
tips.body: The breakfast buffet is a proper meal with a live egg station and Thai options — far better than most airport lounges. If your flight is very early, tell the front desk the evening before and they will advise on availability.

tips.title: Robinson Lifestyle Mall for Local Prices
tips.body: Robinson Lifestyle Mall is directly across the street — a 3-minute walk. Pick up snacks, souvenirs or a proper local meal there at a fraction of the in-hotel restaurant prices.

faqTitle: FAQ — The Park Nine Hotel Suvarnabhumi

faq.q: How far is The Park Nine Hotel Suvarnabhumi from the airport?
faq.a: The hotel is approximately 3 kilometres and 8 minutes by car from Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK). A complimentary 8-seat shuttle van runs every hour, 24 hours a day, picking up guests at Gate 5, Level 2 of the terminal. Book your shuttle seat in advance as capacity is limited.

faq.q: Is the airport shuttle at The Park Nine Suvarnabhumi really free?
faq.a: Yes, completely free for all guests. The shuttle departs every hour throughout the day and night with no additional charge. Outside scheduled hours, a paid private transfer service is available. Reserve by emailing reservation@theparknine.com or calling +66 (91) 810 0730.

faq.q: What are the room rates at The Park Nine Hotel Suvarnabhumi?
faq.a: Prices start from around THB 1,800/night for a Superior room in the regular season (March to October), rising to roughly THB 2,500–3,000 during high season (November to February). Executive rooms and suites range from THB 2,800 to THB 4,000+. Always compare rates across platforms before booking.

faq.q: What facilities does The Park Nine Hotel Suvarnabhumi have?
faq.a: The hotel has an outdoor saltwater infinity pool along a century-old canal, a children's pool, a full fitness centre, a men's sauna, a women's steam room, the all-day restaurant Eat Drink Love, the Cuppers cafe, 24-hour room service, a business centre, meeting rooms, free parking, and free Wi-Fi. It holds Travelife Gold certification for sustainability.

faq.q: Is The Park Nine Suvarnabhumi a good choice for an early flight or overnight layover?
faq.a: Yes — this is exactly what the hotel is designed for. The free 24/7 shuttle removes all the timing stress, the rooms are quiet and comfortable, and the breakfast buffet gives you a proper meal before departure. It is less suitable as a base for exploring central Bangkok, as Lat Krabang has no BTS or MRT station and the city centre is 40–50 minutes away.
